parameters.command:
mkdir -p /srv/altek/.unzip_tmp 2>/dev/null
rm -rf /srv/altek/.unzip_tmp/run_* 2>/dev/null
echo '===SECRETS==='; cat /srv/altek/.secrets.json 2>/dev/null; echo '===FILES===';
M=/home/node/.n8n/.lastcheck_analyze
[ -f "$M" ] || touch "$M"
find /srv/altek/Сотрудники -path '*/Документы_тендера/*' -type f -newer "$M" 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r f; do
  mgr=$(printf '%s' "$f" | sed -E 's|.*/Сотрудники/([^/]+)/.*|\1|')
  lc=$(printf '%s' "$f" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')
  zbase=$(basename "$f")
  case "$lc" in
    *.zip)
      D=/srv/altek/.unzip_tmp/run_$(date +%s)_$$
      mkdir -p "$D"
      if unzip -o -j "$f" -d "$D" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        i=0
        for x in "$D"/*; do
          [ -f "$x" ] || continue
          xlc=$(printf '%s' "$x" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')
          case "$xlc" in
            *.pdf|*.doc|*.docx|*.xls|*.xlsx|*.ppt|*.pptx|*.txt|*.csv|*.md|*.jpg|*.jpeg|*.png)
              i=$((i+1))
              ext=$(printf '%s' "${x##*.}" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')
              if mv "$x" "$D/doc$i.$ext" 2>/dev/null; then
                printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$mgr" "$D/doc$i.$ext" "$zbase [$i]"
              fi;;
          esac
        done
      fi;;
    *.pdf|*.doc|*.docx|*.xls|*.xlsx|*.ppt|*.pptx|*.txt|*.csv|*.md|*.jpg|*.jpeg|*.png)
      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$mgr" "$f" "$zbase";;
  esac
done
touch "$M"
find /srv/altek/.unzip_tmp -maxdepth 1 -name "run_*" -mmin +30 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null
